findings.action: Historical milestones are still reopened by projections. closeoutReviewGate recognizes a pre-adoption milestone approval through milestoneClosedBeforeAdoption (closeout_review_policy.go:376,551), but ReachedMilestones asks only closedByReceipt, which returns false immediately when no receipt exists (closeout_review_policy.go:578-580). The same receipt-only condition appears in milestoneReachedObligations (obligation_projection.go:683) and roadmapReachedApartFrom (roadmaps.go:353). A historically approved milestone under an active roadmap is therefore offered for close again and prevents roadmap-reached suggestions, although closeout-check recognizes its historical contract and does not require a receipt. Use a shared terminal projection that also recognizes verified historical closures; do not backfill receipts. This leaves R7 and the prior historical-state correction incomplete.

closedByReceipt calls getCloseoutState(ref, false), explicitly suppressing dependency acceptance. Under never with no aggregate review, reviewCheck returns the exemption before bundle verification, and closeoutReceiptStands checks only canonical members and exit-gate text. Consequently a receipt whose predecessor or consumed outcome is now unavailable or nonterminal can still read closed to reached, attention and roadmap-reached projections, while GetCloseoutState(ref) with the bound resolver and repeated CLI close reject it. Dependency edges are evaluated only inside the includeFederated branches of review_closeout.go:2764-2792; their definitions include local after/consumes edges as well as remote dependencies (federated_acceptance.go:573-607). Preserve cycle-safe dependency verification in the shared projection instead of disabling that half of terminal verification.

Any nonempty exit gate on a multi-member milestone forces its own aggregate review, including under never and when-justified with exactly two canonical members. TestCloseoutReviewPolicyRoundFour explicitly asserts this additional condition. R3, R4 and D1 instead specify the deterministic member threshold and a close without aggregate review when exempt; preserving exit-gate verification is a separate obligation, not an approved additional review-policy predicate. POSE.md:374 also documents the original threshold without this exception. Provide independent exit-gate evidence while honoring the selected review mode, or obtain an explicit spec/decision change for the additional aggregate-review requirement.

Backward Markdown targets are checked with Lstat and containment only; they are never read or resolved through GetRoadmap. For example, an inventoried ADR linking to ../roadmaps/other.md whose directory entry is regular but whose content cannot be read produces no diagnostic while evaluating another roadmap. The evaluator can therefore report Known=true and prove absence despite an unreadable local association target. The adjacent roadmaps: declaration path does perform GetRoadmap and detects this condition at line 173. Apply equivalent real target resolution to Markdown links and test ReadFile failure separately from missing-file and symlink cases, as required by R3's association contract.
